references.text: Levitical purity laws require that the one who is unclean must wash with water and remain unclean until evening, which corresponds to the cleansing procedure in Deuteronomy.
Describes how a person becomes clean at sunset after washing themselves, following the same pattern as in Deuteronomy 23:12.
Refers to cleansing with water and becoming clean in the evening, parallel to instructions to wash and wait until sunset.
Instructs that whoever touches something unclean must be unclean until evening and must wash their clothes—the same timeframe for cleansing.
Concerns washing with water for purification and remaining unclean until evening, following the same cleansing pattern as in the main text.
